Given
When
Then
 Thing { Given:text, When:int, Then:bool }
 scenario Given(When:text) by=members
  do return When
  examples
   When -> When
   Then -> Given

app Shop uses=[sales]
package sales
 Given
  role approver
  contract Item {cost:money}
  derive Item.total:money=row.cost
  derive total(x:money):money=x
  fixture initial=Item {cost=money(1,USD)}
  message caption = "Item"@{}
 When
  scenario approve(item:Item) by=approver
   do call total {x=item.cost}
 Then
  page /items title=caption
   form approve
   actions approve,Item.create

derive Task.done:bool = row.completed!=null
 derive Task.name:text = row.title
 derive by_name(name:text):text=name
 policy Task read=members fields=done,name

fixture first=Item {}; fixture second=Item {}
 message one="One"@{}; message two="Two"@{}
 derive one():int=1; derive two():int=2
 role first; role second
 scenario run() by=members
  do let first=1; let second=2; return first+second
 export role first; export role second

contract Sample {
  value:A | B[]?,
  action:action(A.run,B.send)?,
  names:text[]! min=1,
  reused:Contract.rows!
 }
 scenario show(
  input:A |
   B,
  action:action(A.run)
 ) by=members -> A | B
  do return input

Thing {value:trim, other:unique, rest:server, low:min, high:max, caption:label, mode:enum, task:action}
 Thing {items:a.trim, other:b.label, nullable:trim?, union:A|unique, compound:A | unique}

derive f():bool = value.return and true
 derive g():bool = value.where or false
 derive h():bool = x+in
 derive i():bool = x+ in
 derive j():bool = x * and
 derive k():bool = a
 derive l():bool = and or in
 derive m():bool = from is Type
 derive n():bool = value.not and true

derive rows():Item[] = (Item
  as item
  where item.active
  order=-item.created
  select item
 )
 derive values():bool = any(Item as item,item.active)
 derive grouped():json = group(Item as item,item.state)

derive a():Item[] = order as row where row.active
 derive b():Item[] = from as row select row
 derive c():Item[] = where as row select row
 derive d():Item[] = action as row select row
 derive e():Item[] = value.select as row select row
 derive f():Item[] = (order) as row select row
 derive g():Item[] = Item archived=include as item where item.active order=-item.created select item

Given

export capability Remote version=1
  load(id:text)->Item; save(item:Item)->bool
  event Updated {item:Item}
  another(
   id:text
  )->Item
 role manager
When
Then

page / title="Root"
 page /items/{pkg.Item.id} title="Item"
 page /types/{selection:A|B[]?} title="Types"
 page /kinds/{kind:enum(one,two)} title="Kinds"
 page /acts/{target:action(pkg.first,pkg.second)} title="Actions"

scenario execute(input:Item) by=members
  require input.active message="Required"
  do
   create Item {active=true} as item
   set item {active=false}
   call pkg.run {input=item} as result
   emit Changed {item}
   send Remote.run {item} when=input.active as delivery
   schedule item at=now+1h event=Changed {item}
   cancel item.reminder
   delete item
   return result

page /items title=caption poll=5s refresh=refresh
  require members
  card caption
   form Item.create import=csv review=preview
  table Item columns=title,status order={by=preferences.view,default=[-created],cases={open=[title]}} filter=status defaults={status=open}
   title row.title
   actions approve,Item.update
   history

migration Rename from="old"
 rename owner
 rename before.Task to Work
 rename before.Task.title to Work.name
 drop before.Task.old
 invalidate before.refresh
 backfill Work
  require before.title!=null
  do
   let text=before.title
   if text!=""
    set row {name=text}
   else
    set row {name="Untitled"}

derive values():json = [0,12,12.25,1ms,2s,3m,4h,5d,6B,7KiB,8MiB,9GiB,-5,"a\n\u0041","# ## #= @{"]
## Invalid spellings below are negative lexical probes, not valid programs.
 derive invalid():json = [5minutes,1.5h,1e3,1_000,'x']

scenario run(not:text,true:text,false:text,null:text) by=members
  do let and=1; let or=2; return and+or
 Thing {not:text,true:bool,false:int,null:json}
 policy Thing read=members fields=not,true,false,null
 page / title="T"
  table Thing columns=not,true,false,null
   text row.not,row.true,row.false,row.null

scenario process() by=members
 do
  for in in values limit=1
   let selected=values as where where where.active
  let found=values as select where select.active select select
  let row=record.return and true

crud Item by=members fields=title
 examples create
  title -> count(Item)
  "First" -> 1
 examples update item=first
  title -> item.title
  "New" -> "New"
 examples delete item=first
  as -> count(Item)
